settings.heading: Go Big. Stay Legal: Federally Approved Lift Packages for Your RAM 2500HD 6th Gen

settings.text:
A 6" Lift on 40s, Still Under 4.5 Tonnes, Still on Your Car Licence

If you have held off building a serious RAM 2500HD because you did not want to cross into truck licence territory, these packages are for you.

Through our Federally Approved Second Stage Manufacture (SSM) approval, Offroad Industries can fit up to a 6-inch lift on 40-inch tyres while your RAM 2500HD stays rated at its factory 4495 KG GVM - inside the NB1 category, so a standard car licence is all you need.

What This Means For You

These are lift and suspension packages, not GVM upgrades. GVM stays at 4495 KG and Gross Combined Mass stays at 12474 KG across every stage, so payload moves only with the weight of the kit fitted. What you gain is stance, clearance, tyre size and ride quality - all engineered as one certified package.

Looking for extra payload instead? Our GVM upgrade packages for the same vehicle take GVM to 5890 KG. Talk to our team about which suits you.

settings.subheading: Stage 1: SSM Approved — Pre & Post Rego

settings.text:
The entry point to the NB1 range: a genuine two inch lift on Fox 2.5 HTO shocks, with the factory 4495 KG rating untouched.

  • GVM: 4495 KG | GCM: 12474 KG | Braked Towing: 4500 KG
  • Payload: 735 KG, based on kerb weight
  • Lift & Tyres: 2" lift, running up to 35x12.5 R18 or 35x12.5 R20.
  • Key Features: Fox 2.5 Performance Series HTO shocks front and rear, Husky Extenda flares colour coded to your vehicle, ORI mud flap brackets.
  • Best For: Daily drivers and light tourers who want the stance and the tyre without changing licence class.
  • Approval: VTA-064942
  • Kit Number: RAM6-2500-Stage1-NB1

settings.title: RAM 2500HD 6th Gen SSM Lift Packages — Big Truck Stance on a Car Licence
settings.content:
The RAM 2500HD 6th Gen is already one of the most capable heavy duty utes delivered in Australia. What stops most owners building one properly is not the truck, it is the paperwork: lift it and fit big tyres the usual way and you either end up non-compliant or pushed over 4.5 tonnes and into truck licence territory.

Our Second Stage Manufacture packages solve that. Every stage is engineered and certified as a complete package while the vehicle stays at its factory 4495 KG GVM, inside the NB1 category. A standard car licence covers you, and the build is legal Australia wide.

settings.title: What an NB1 SSM Package Is — and What It Is Not
settings.content:
These are lift and suspension packages. GVM stays at 4495 KG and Gross Combined Mass stays at 12474 KG on every stage, so they do not add payload. Payload actually moves slightly with the weight of the kit fitted, from 735 KG on Stage 1 to 665 KG on the six inch stages.

What you get is height, clearance, tyre size and a properly engineered suspension package behind it. If your problem is weight rather than height, our GVM upgrade range for the same vehicle lifts GVM to 5890 KG instead - ask our team which one fits what you are doing.

settings.title: How to Choose Your Stage
settings.content:
Stages 1 and 2 are both a two inch lift on 35 inch tyres, so the choice between them is the suspension: Stage 1 runs Fox 2.5 HTO shocks, Stage 2 steps up to Fox 2.5 Performance Elite reservoir shocks with ORI load rated coils front and rear.

Stage 3 is the first stage to clear a 37 inch tyre, with a three inch lift and a BDS radius arm kit correcting the front geometry. Stage 4 takes the same package to four inches. Stages 5 and 6 move to the six inch platform, with Stage 6 running Fox coil-overs and clearing a 40 inch tyre.

Stages 1 to 3 are available Pre and Post Rego. Stages 4, 5 and 6 are Pre Rego only. Not sure which suits you? Talk to our team.

settings.title: Compliance, Insurance and Registration
settings.content:
Offroad Industries is a Federally Approved Second Stage Manufacturer, so these packages are recorded on the federal database rather than signed off as a one-off modification. That is what makes them legal in every state and territory without a separate engineering certificate in each one.

Every package is engineered to the Australian Design Rules and comes with its documentation, so your insurance and warranty position is clear and on paper. We handle the certification and the paperwork.

settings.title: Why ORI for Your RAM 2500HD 6th Gen
settings.content:
These packages were developed for the 6th Gen platform specifically, not adapted from the 5th Gen or another vehicle, and tested under Australian conditions. Fox Suspension and BDS are our key partners, so every stage runs components built for the load rather than generic parts.

From fitting and engineering through to certification and handover, ORI does the lot. Browse the stages above or get in touch to start your build.
